panel.title: Columns
panel.description: The columns of this experiment: parameters you set and results you measure. Samples recorded before a column was added simply have no value for it.
panel.empty: No columns yet. Add the settings you vary or the results you measure, such as a temperature or a thickness.
panel.inUse: Samples hold values for this column, or a calculated column uses it, so it cannot be deleted.

form.description: Columns belong to this experiment. Samples recorded earlier keep their values and show a new column empty.
form.unitHint: Optional, for example W, s or °C.
form.kindLocked: The type cannot change once samples hold values for this column.

errors.nameRequired: Enter a name for the column.
errors.nameDuplicate: This experiment already has a column with that name.
errors.defaultNotANumber: Enter a number, for example 1.5, or leave it empty.
errors.resultHasDefault: A result cannot have a default value.

form.defaultHint: Optional. Prefills this parameter in each new sample. Samples already recorded keep their own values.

roleHint.parameter: A setting you choose for the sample, such as a temperature or a duration.
roleHint.result: Something you measure on the sample afterwards, such as a thickness. It is never prefilled.
